cited.quote: To enable this, if necessary Article 343 of the Constitution should be suitably amended.

rationale: C1 (Governor's address) states the government will continue to urge the Union and that Article 343 should be amended if necessary; this is a statement of intent, not a formal step such as an Assembly resolution or CM letter. C2-C5 are unrelated.
No extract concerns cable cars or winch lines to hill temples. C1-C2 are energy distribution, C3 temple bus services, C4-C5 highway works.

cited.quote: Presently mobile app for payments is under usage by Consumers.

rationale: C1 discusses electricity bill payment and assessment apps, but shows no step to discontinue existing payment methods or to have payment made to the meter-reading official. Other extracts unrelated.

cited.quote: permit the sale of Palm Jaggery through select Fair Price Shops run by Cooperatives
as per the indent given by District Consumer Cooperative Wholesale Stores / Agricultural Producers Cooperative Marketing Societies

rationale: C1/C3 GO (30.09.2021) has cooperative societies, including Agricultural Producers Cooperative Marketing Societies, obtain palm jaggery on indent and sell it on a pilot basis, but supply comes through the Khadi and Village Industries Board rather than direct procurement. Partly matches the promise.

cited.quote: This Government will urge the Government of India to remove the income criteria for determining the creamy layer

rationale: C1 concerns urging the Union on OBC creamy layer, a neighbouring issue; no extract shows a formal step urging the Union on Mandal recommendations or 27% OBC reservation in IITs and teacher appointments. C2-C5 concern state reservation and other matters.
No extract concerns medical emergency centres along district highways. C1/C3/C5 are road upgradation norms, C2 road safety generally, C4 COVID protocol.
C1-C5 are transfers and postings of police officers, not recruitment to fill police vacancies annually. Nothing about the commitment.
C1, C2, C4, C5 revise minimum wages and C3 lists holidays; none concerns overtime wages for working on holidays.

cited.quote: OPERATIONAL GUIDELINES FOR ESTABLISHMENT OF RURAL AGRICULTURE MARKET IN YEDAPALLI VILLAGE OF NILGIRIS DISTRICT FOR FARMERS
Establishment of Integrated Rural Agricultural Market Complex at Edappally village, Nilgiris District

rationale: C1 GO (25.10.2021) sanctions and sets guidelines for one government-supervised rural agriculture market in Nilgiris, announced in C4. Only a single market is covered, not rural markets generally.
C1 covers handloom schemes generally, C2-C3 textile commissionerate, C4-C5 agriculture; none concerns housing subsidy for weavers.
No extract concerns subsidy for goat or poultry farms run by groups of widowed, abandoned or destitute women. C1-C5 are general agriculture and livestock items.

cited.quote: farmers who struggle at the national capital with brave hearts to agitate against the farm laws

rationale: C1 dedicates the agriculture budget to farmers protesting the farm laws but shows no Assembly resolution. Other extracts are unrelated.
C1, C3, C5 discuss metro projects and transport generally, C4 bus fare concessions without students; none concerns subsidised metro fares for students.

cited.quote: A total sum of Rs.433.97 crore has been allocated for construction of fishing harbours and 25 fish landing centres

rationale: C1 is a budget allocation for fishing harbours and 25 fish landing centres, which does not count as operationalisation and does not cover all fishing villages. Other extracts unrelated.
C1 mentions Salem Steel Plant only as a COVID care centre site; no extract concerns expansion or modernisation of steel plants in Salem.

cited.quote: The lumpsum amount payable under Tamil Nadu Government Servants’ Family Security Fund Scheme shall be enhanced to Rs.5,00,000/-
a sum of Rs.5,00,000/- ( Rupees Five Lakh only) shall be paid to the legal heirs

rationale: C3 GO (01.09.2021) raises the lumpsum paid on death of government employees in service to Rs.5 lakh; C2 GO of the same date extends Rs.5 lakh to employees under the Group Insurance Scheme. Some doubt whether the promise means these employees.

cited.quote: The beneficiaries are provided with CASHLESS treatment with adequate facilities without the need to pay any deposits

rationale: C2/C3 describe the general employee health insurance scheme, a broader scheme not specific to free treatment of police injured on duty. C1, C4, C5 unrelated. No dedicated step shown.
C2/C5 concern renewal of dam spillway gates, C3 check dams, C1 business rules, C4 road works; none concerns sluice gates preventing seawater entering a canal.
C3 is a green park in one constituency, C1-C2 industrial parks, C4 housing, C5 urban infrastructure; none concerns Semmozhi Parks in Municipal Corporations.

cited.quote: it is planned to establish a new Research Centre for Turmeric in Bhavanisagar of Erode District

rationale: C1 is a budget announcement of a planned turmeric research centre in Erode district; no GO or other official step appears. C2-C5 are unrelated.
